questions.stem: How is a nerve cell (neurone) adapted to transmit electrical impulses over long distances?

options.text: It has a large vacuole to store neurotransmitters
It has a long axon covered by a myelin sheath for insulation
It has a thick cell wall to protect the impulse
It has many chloroplasts to provide energy

questions.explanation: Nerve cells have a long axon that carries electrical impulses over great distances, and the myelin sheath insulates the axon, speeding up the transmission of these impulses.
